parts: Female born on October 10, 1996. HD: B-A. Shoulder height: 59 cm. ACABE Sociability test: PASSED.
DNA-identified at the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine in León.

From the cross of world champion lines with the best Spanish lines. A granddaughter of Vigilat's Dear Davy Jori, her pedigree includes dogs from the most important European lines. She arrived at our home on November 16, 1996.

At 11 months, she began her career at Spanish shows. Her results in junior class were excellent, reaching the group podium on several occasions. She continued strongly in Open Class. At 17 months, she placed Excellent 4 at the Spanish Specialty Show against strong competition. Her career since then has been unstoppable, earning Excellent 2 RCAC on four occasions at the obligatory point for the championship, CACQC (obligatory point for the Portuguese championship) at Porto'00, and B.I.S. at the III Open Acabe held in Valladolid in 2001, with her Sociability Test PASSED. Her last three appearances were at obligatory point shows, and she achieved Excellent 2 RCAC at all of them.

On September 29, 2002, she appeared again at the International Dog Show of León, achieving Exc. 1 CAC, CACIB, Best Female, Best of Breed, Best in Group and 4th in BIS, passing the scrutiny of three prestigious foreign international judges.

She reached full maturity when she became a mother for the first time on July 7, 2000, passing on her intelligence, bearing and elegance to her offspring. She now lives retired from showing and breeding, and we enjoy every moment of her presence.
She is the mother of our litters A, B, F and H.
She is fully retired and enjoying a happy old age, although she still feels like a puppy and plays all day despite being almost 12 years old.
